about_the_game:
Welcome to [b]RestoRuzz[/b], the most chaotic restaurant as far as the eye can see!

Get ready for a fast-paced, laughter-filled cooking experience where teamwork, time management, and quick thinking are the key ingredients to success. Designed for both single and multiplayer, RestoRuzz blends frantic food prep, unpredictable customer behavior and roguelike-style progression into one deliciously challenging game.

Work side by side with your friends (or solo!) to take customer orders, cook dishes and serve food before time runs out. As you earn money, you’ll be able to upgrade your kitchen, unlock new recipes, and promote your restaurant to attract even more hungry (and sometimes demanding) customers.

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]

  • Chaotic Co-op Cooking: Team up locally with up to 4 players and coordinate your kitchen like pros

  • Upgrade Your Restaurant: Use your hard-earned cash to buy new equipment, expand your kitchen, and unlock strategic upgrades

  • Colorful 2D Art Style: Dive into a cartoony underwater world full of quirky characters, charming animations, and vibrant kitchens

  • Strategic Teamwork: Delegate roles, manage time, and adapt quickly as chaos builds with every order

  • Designed for Local Multiplayer: Perfect for families, friends, and party gaming nights (keyboard and controller support)

Whether you're a solo chef or part of a full kitchen crew, RestoRuzz will test your skills, your friendships and your ability to cook under pressure.

Are you ready to build your restaurant empire?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel i5-4570
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 600 / Intel HD Graphics 520
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game may experience short stutters on very low-end devices, especially on first load or in hectic gameplay moments.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i5-10400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth gameplay in multiplayer sessions and when playing on higher resolutions.

short_description: A fast-paced cooperative restaurant sim where 1–4 players cook, serve, and upgrade their chaotic kitchen while tackling unpredictable customers and roguelite challenges.
